title: How Small Businesses Can Embrace AI | Insights

facts.fact: BT's article 'How small businesses can embrace AI' was published on 08 January 2025.
The article gives an estimated reading time of 5 minutes.
BT's experts outline five key AI trends that they say can transform small businesses.
facts.quote: Our experts outline the five key AI trends that can transform small businesses, and how to get started.

facts.fact: The five AI trends named in the article are AI-driven content creation, personalisation at scale, smarter customer service, automated sales and marketing insights, and efficient inventory and supply chain management.
facts.quote: Here we share five key AI trends helping small businesses and why embracing this technology can be a game-changer for a small business.

facts.fact: BT states that AI chatbots can handle common customer queries around the clock, outside normal business hours.
facts.quote: AI chatbots can handle common queries around the clock, ensuring a customers get timely answers outside of normal business hours.

facts.fact: BT claims there are affordable, even free, AI tools aimed specifically at small businesses; the page gives no prices.
facts.quote: there are affordable, even free, AI tools that cater specifically to small businesses.

facts.fact: BT names ChatGPT, MSN Clarity and Canva Content Planner as tools for integrating AI-driven personalisation into marketing, and Google AI for Data Analytics and Zoho CRM as AI analytics tools.
